summary: OMEGA reconciles research-only ASCENDANCY architecture search with revision-bound per-lane peer source witnesses: architecture novelty may generate research hypotheses, but cross-repository lane state must remain exact-source-bound and cannot become substantive evidence or execution authority.

athena.finding: Treat ASCENDANCY-generated hypotheses as research candidates only; uncertainty cannot fall from novelty alone, and peer lane state must pass exact source-blob witness verification.

janus.finding: Track architecture genome/evaluation-contract identity separately from peer packet source_commit and per-lane heartbeat/finalization blob witnesses; neither substitutes for substantive evidence.

infrastructure.finding: Icarus-engine now binds local peer lane heartbeat/finalization state to exact Git blob witnesses and verifies them against source revision, while no newer substantive Flow/DAEDALUS finding was established.

helios_prime.finding: Integrate ASCENDANCY's open-ended research frontier with the federated evidence fabric only through provenance-bound, authority-limited adapters; preserve zero execution/production authority.
